question: A patient in the neonatal intensive care unit develops severe cyanosis. Cardiac exam reveals a single loud S2 with a right ventricular heave. Echocardiography reveals an aorta lying anterior and right of the pulmonary artery. Which of the following processes failed during fetal development?

options.opa: Fusion of the membranous ventricular septum
options.opd: Reentry of viscera from yolk sac
options.ope: Fusion of septum primum and septum secondum
